fields.name: Streams
fields.evidence: The roll streams, 0x78 bytes each: SystemUpdate<esv::roll::stream::SaveSystem> (bg3_dx11.exe+0x23993CC) copies the roll manager's array (manager+0x8) into +0x0 element by element with the stream copy at bg3_dx11.exe+0x105DB40 when the manager has changes; a hardware watch (GK.Memory.Watch) on the first element's +0x70 hit inside that copy, and the value read there by GK.Memory.Read equals the Lua Streams[1].State.NumRolls.

fields.name: LastStreamId
fields.evidence: SaveStreams (+0x342D9D0) copies the roll manager's +0x18 here; that field watched over the first dialogue check went 1->2 at +0x309FD9E in CreateStream as the second stream (Dialog, id 2) was made; GK.Rolls.Streams().saved.frame read 1 with one stream. Script Extender calls it LastFrame

fields.name: BaseSeed
fields.evidence: Written when the component is made, by bg3_dx11.exe+0x342D9D0 (called from SystemUpdate<esv::roll::stream::SaveSystem>): the C runtime's _time64(NULL) stored at +0x18. Read live: GK.Memory.Read(ComponentAddress+0x18,'uint64') equals the Lua BaseSeed and the Unix time of the load in seconds; two loads' values differ by the seconds between them (tests/rolls/save/load.lua).
